cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.
